steps.name: G04 bounded overlap and private paths
steps.run:
set -eu
key=${G04_PROOF_TOKEN:?parent must bind unique proof token}-$CI_MATRIX_lane
for dir in "$HOME" "$TMPDIR" "$XDG_CACHE_HOME"; do test ! -e "$dir/g04-owner"; printf '%s' "$key" > "$dir/g04-owner"; done
sid=$(/bin/ps -p $$ -o sid= | tr -d ' ')
printf 'G04_PATHS token=%s lane=%s pid=%s sid=%s pwd=%s home=%s tmp=%s cache=%s\n' "$G04_PROOF_TOKEN" "$CI_MATRIX_lane" "$$" "$sid" "$PWD" "$HOME" "$TMPDIR" "$XDG_CACHE_HOME"
printf 'G04_BEGIN token=%s lane=%s uptime=%s\n' "$G04_PROOF_TOKEN" "$CI_MATRIX_lane" "$(awk '{print $1}' /proc/uptime)"
sleep 3
for dir in "$HOME" "$TMPDIR" "$XDG_CACHE_HOME"; do test "$(cat "$dir/g04-owner")" = "$key"; done
printf 'G04_END token=%s lane=%s uptime=%s\n' "$G04_PROOF_TOKEN" "$CI_MATRIX_lane" "$(awk '{print $1}' /proc/uptime)"
